resources.string: Your coach calls punches by number.\nTwo minutes to learn them, then a quick game.

Left foot forward, right foot back.
Hands up by your cheeks, elbows in.

The fighter in the pictures faces you,
so their left hand is on your right.
Left-handed? Mirror everything.
Lead (left) hand, straight out.\nFast — snap it back to your guard.
Rear (right) hand, straight.\nTurn your hip and back foot into it.
Left hook. Elbow up at shoulder height,\nswing in from the side.
Right hook. Same shape,\nthrown off the back side.
Left uppercut. Dip a little\nand drive the fist up from below.
Right uppercut. Push off\nthe back foot and lift.

1, 3, 5 are your left hand.
2, 4, 6 are your right hand.

Straight, hook, uppercut — in pairs.
Slip: move your head to the side.\nDuck under: bend your knees and dip.\nHands up: back to your guard.
Close distance: step in.\nMake distance: step back out of range.\nMove more: keep your feet busy.

"1-2" means jab then cross, back to back.

The coach says numbers or punch names —
choose Numbers or Words on the home screen.
Start with Coach mode on Beginner.\n\nReplay this tutorial any time with the ? button on the home screen or in Settings.
Tap the punches in the order the coach calls them.
Nice start. Play again, or move on.
